author: Scott Manley
description:
Trying to make a video from my hotel room covering my whole experience with the Artemis II launch, I was there as part of a YouTube sponsored event that pulled a diverse group of people together, unlike the media site or NASA Social event. 
I was the 'space dad' that told everyone what to expect.

And then for the last few days I've been trying to get the time and energy to share some of this using my laptop, so, apologies in advance for the slapdash editing and dubious audio, I'll be back home soon.

title: Artemis II: Was it Everything I Expected?
